description: Use when tracking competitive threats to an incumbent vendor or identifying switching trends in a software category. Returns vendors mentioned as replacements for a target vendor with switch narrative and mention counts. Example: Salesforce displacement — HubSpot replacing in SMB at 28 mentions, Dynamics replacing in enterprise at 19 — highest displacement pressure in mid-market 100-500 employees. Source: Stratalize citation displacement composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_competitive_displacement_signal
title: Get Competitive Displacement Signal
